_doc: Two xpp_create_class requests (contract first, then event) for a business event raised when a sales order invoice is posted. Shape follows the shipped SalesInvoicePostedBusinessEvent / ...Contract pair.
Before: add labels MyInvoicePostedBusinessEventName / MyInvoicePostedBusinessEventDescription to your label file (dynamics-xpp:xpp-labelfile). The attribute references them WITHOUT the @.

After: raise it. For a sales invoice that is a Chain-of-Command extension of the posting class (dynamics-xpp:xpp-extension); for your own document, the method that persists the fact, after super()/the write, inside the transaction.
Then compile, rebuild the business events catalog, activate the event for a legal entity and an endpoint, and perform the business action.
